goal: Prepare a surgical refactor plan + code scaffolding for voxel-column tiles + 2.5D tilt rendering (no integration yet).
assumptions: Logical grid remains (x,y) with CHUNK_SIZE=64 and TILE_WORLD=16.
Existing TileLayers.heightLevel[] is the canonical per-tile terraced height channel.
Phase 1 is voxel-columns only (no caves, no per-z materials).
openQuestions: Height value range policy: keep 0..15 (biome mask) vs extend.
Editor wheel binding policy for height editing vs zoom.
Movement rules regarding height (ignore vs constrain).

steps.desc: Write the surgical refactor plan document with explicit dependency/removal points and prepared modules list.
verify: Document references existing code files and current seams (no guessed APIs).
Includes removal points: where heightLevel is currently zeroed in area loaders.
steps.notes: Plan written with references to World, TileLayers, JsonAreaWorldLoader, AreaWorldApplier, ChunkRenderer, EntityRenderer, SaveManager, WorldEditorScreen.

steps.desc: Prepare new helper code stubs (codec + render mapping + side regions) with TODO and reference anchors, without wiring into runtime.
verify: Files compile syntactically (static inspection only).
No call-site integration changes done.
steps.notes: Added prepared stubs: VoxelHeightCodec (Base64 heightLevel JSON), VoxelRenderMapping (tilt + lift constants), VoxelSideRegions (side face mapping stub). No call-site integration.

steps.desc: Prepare editor persistence skeleton methods (persist/load heightLevel) as isolated helpers (not wired), referencing existing tileTrees persistence pattern.
verify: Only adds helper methods or clearly isolated TODO blocks; does not change behavior.
steps.notes: Added prepared (unused) helper skeletons in WorldEditorScreen for persisting and applying layers.heightLevel; save hook is present but commented out to avoid behavior change.

steps.desc: Prepare renderer scaffolding hooks for voxel/tilt (ChunkRenderer + EntityRenderer) as unused helper methods/TODO blocks only (no behavior change).
verify: Only adds unused helpers/comments; no call paths changed.
No new dependencies introduced beyond existing imports.
steps.notes: Added unused scaffolding methods: ChunkRenderer.drawVoxelColumnsStub(...) and EntityRenderer.sortKeyWithVoxelLiftStub(...). No call paths changed.

steps.desc: Prepare area loader scaffolding for authored heightLevel (JsonAreaWorldLoader + AreaWorldApplier) as isolated helpers and commented hooks (no behavior change).
verify: Only adds unused helpers/comments; no runtime behavior changes.
Explicitly references VoxelHeightCodec for future integration.
steps.notes: Added commented call sites + unused helper skeletons applyAuthoredHeightLevelFromJson(...) in both runtime JsonAreaWorldLoader and editor AreaWorldApplier; no behavior change.

steps.desc: Prepare a dedicated height editing helper (not wired): data extraction from preview world -> byte[] and byte[] -> preview world apply, plus brush math placeholders.
verify: Standalone utility class only; no call sites changed.
No behavior change in editor/runtime.
steps.notes: Added standalone HeightLevelEditing utility with JSON codec wrappers + export/import/brush placeholders; no wiring into editor/runtime.

steps.desc: Integrate HEIGHT as a terrain layer target in the area editor and allow brush edits to modify TileLayers.heightLevel; persistence already handled by heightLevel save/load wiring.
verify: HEIGHT appears in terrain layer select box.
applyToolAt handles LayerTarget.HEIGHT and modifies previewWorld heightLevel with brush.
save writes layers.heightLevel via VoxelHeightCodec.
steps.notes: Added LayerTarget.HEIGHT + terrainLayerBox entry; applyToolAt modifies heightLevel via HeightLevelEditing.applyDeltaAt (clamp 0..15).

steps.desc: Make height visible: lift tile rendering by heightLevel and apply simple 2.5D tilt mapping in ChunkRenderer (top faces only).
verify: ChunkRenderer uses TileLayers.heightLevel to compute lift and adjusts y.
No side faces yet; this step is top-face visibility only.
steps.notes: ChunkRenderer now applies VoxelRenderMapping.liftWorld(heightLevel) + tiltY() per tile before drawing ground/water/overlays.

steps.desc: Match entities to voxel lift/tilt: EntityRenderer uses World.heightLevelAtWorldPeek for visual lift and includes lift in sortKey; GameScreen provides world ref via setter.
verify: EntityRenderer applies VoxelRenderMapping.liftWorld + tiltY to entity y.
sortKey includes lift so ordering remains consistent.
GameScreen calls entityRenderer.setWorld(world).
steps.notes: Entities are now visually lifted/tilted to match tiles; sort key includes lift; world ref is injected via setter to keep API narrow.

steps.desc: Bring tileTrees rendering into the voxel mapping: apply heightLevel lift + tilt in EntityRenderer.drawTileTreesChunk so dense forests sit on raised tiles.
verify: drawTileTreesChunk adjusts wx/wy by heightLevel using VoxelRenderMapping.
steps.notes: TileTrees draw path now applies heightLevel lift + tilt mapping using the chunk-local heightLevel array.

steps.desc: Fix editor picking under voxel/tilt: introduce a screen->tile mapping that inverts tilt and compensates one-step for height lift; use it across paint/move/zone/tileTree drags.
verify: All viewport.unproject->floor(tx/ty) paths for map interactions route through screenToTile().
TileTree drag uses screenToTile().
steps.notes: Added screenToTile() inversion helper and wired it into onMapPaint, begin/update zone drag, begin/update move drag, and updateTileTreeDrag. Also set entityRenderer world in editor so visuals match tiles.

steps.desc: Render voxel cliffs: draw vertical south/west faces based on height differences to neighbors (visual only).
verify: ChunkRenderer draws downward faces proportional to (h0 - hNeighbor) using the same height step as lift.
Road tiles skip face drawing to avoid floating-road artifacts.
steps.notes: Replaced thin edge shadows with actual vertical faces (south full width + west strip) using tiles.waterFill tinted; height uses HEIGHT_STEP_WORLD*TILT_Y_SCALE.

steps.desc: Lock Phase 1 behavior: heightLevel is visual-only; movement/collision remains height-agnostic. Document the policy and Phase 2 seam.
verify: Document explicitly states visual-only policy and references World/AiSystem queries.
No gameplay code changed in this step.
steps.notes: Added DOCS/VOXEL_PHASE1_BEHAVIOR_NOTES.md to prevent accidental half-constraints; confirms AI uses isBlocked/isWater only.

steps.desc: Align procedural grass jitter rendering with voxel lift/tilt so tufts don't float under elevated tiles.
verify: Grass jitter draw uses c.layers.heightLevel[idx2] and applies VoxelRenderMapping lift+tilt before drawing.
steps.notes: ChunkRenderer grass jitter now adds liftWorld(heightLevel) and tiltY to py (and shear to px) before drawing tufts.

steps.desc: Fix gameplay input and UI world-to-screen anchors under voxel/tilt: adjust key cam.project/unproject call sites (mouseWorld, lamp mask, area red-zone arrows, merchant shop anchor).
verify: updateMouseWorld undoes tilt + lift before setting mouseWorldX/Y.
cam.project anchors use lift+tilt adjusted positions for px/py and merchant head.
steps.notes: Adjusted updateMouseWorld (unproject inversion) and multiple cam.project anchor points to use VoxelRenderMapping lift+tilt so UI remains aligned with rendered world.

steps.desc: Align world overlays with voxel render-space: cursor and health bars use lift+tilt mapping so they sit on raised tiles/entities.
verify: cursorController.renderWorldCursor receives voxel render-space coords.
drawEntityHealthBarsWorld maps entity/tileTree positions through toVoxelRenderSpace before drawing bars.
steps.notes: Added toVoxelRenderSpace helper; cursor and health bar anchors now use render-space positions under tilt/lift.

steps.desc: Align world-space shape veils with voxel render-space: draw AREA red-zone border as quads in render-space using triangles.
verify: Red-zone veil uses toVoxelRenderSpace for corners and is drawn with ShapeRenderer.triangle quads.
steps.notes: Replaced axis-aligned shape.rect border strips with filled quads mapped through toVoxelRenderSpace so veil aligns under tilt/lift.

steps.desc: Align Fog of War world overlay with voxel render-space: draw FoW texture as a mapped quad instead of axis-aligned rect.
verify: renderFogOfWarOverlayWorld draws fowTex using batch.draw(Texture, x1,y1,x2,y2,x3,y3,x4,y4, u/v...) with corners mapped by toVoxelRenderSpace.
steps.notes: FoW overlay now respects tilt by mapping the area rectangle corners through toVoxelRenderSpace and drawing as a quad.

steps.desc: Align projectile visuals with voxel render-space: arrow line draw uses toVoxelRenderSpace so it appears attached to tilted/lifted world.
verify: drawArrowsWorld maps arrow start position through toVoxelRenderSpace before drawing the line.
steps.notes: Arrow visualization now uses render-space coords for start point; tail vector remains in local direction for readability.

steps.desc: Align action overlay with voxel render-space: map FOV cone vertices and approximate the action ring outline in render space.
verify: drawActionOverlay uses toVoxelRenderSpace for center and segment endpoints.
Ring is drawn as line segments between render-space points (not shape.circle at px/py).
steps.notes: Action overlay now follows voxel mapping: FOV sector uses render-space triangles, ring uses polyline in render space.

steps.desc: Harden dot cursor rendering under voxel/tilt: ensure drawDotCursorWorld maps coords into render-space so all call sites remain correct.
verify: drawDotCursorWorld applies toVoxelRenderSpace before drawing circles.
steps.notes: drawDotCursorWorld now maps incoming coords via toVoxelRenderSpace for consistency across callers.

steps.desc: Confirm fullscreen overlays remain screen-space: day/night overlay, boot overlay, and dnMask are drawn in UI/screen coords and require no voxel mapping changes.
verify: Overlays use batch.draw(..., 0,0, screenW, screenH) in UI/screen-space blocks, not cam.combined world-space.
No code changes required beyond documentation/checklist.
steps.notes: Day/night and boot overlays are screen-space by design; left unchanged under voxel/tilt.

steps.desc: Fix cursor warp-to-ring under voxel/tilt: when clamping aim to action ring, project render-space position before setting OS cursor.
verify: updateMouseWorld clamp-to-ring calls toVoxelRenderSpace before cam.project(p).
steps.notes: Aim clamp warp now projects render-space coords, preventing cursor drift under tilt/lift.

steps.desc: Confirm Phase 1 rule: all spawn/movement/streaming operates in logical 2D (px/py), without applying voxel render offsets; document in checklist.
verify: No modifications to spawn/movement code paths in this step.
Rendering-only mapping is centralized via VoxelRenderMapping / toVoxelRenderSpace.
steps.notes: Phase 1 keeps gameplay logic in flat 2D; only rendering/picking/projection paths use voxel mapping.

steps.desc: Unify cliff face sprite selection behind a single mapping point: route cliff face draws through VoxelSideRegions (explicit placeholder until real side art exists).
verify: ChunkRenderer cliff face draws use VoxelSideRegions.sideForGroundId(..., tiles) instead of direct tiles.waterFill().
steps.notes: Cliff faces now pull their region from VoxelSideRegions (currently returns tiles.waterFill as a loud placeholder, tinted by caller).

steps.desc: Unify render-space mapping math: replace inline tilt/shear operations with VoxelRenderMapping.mapY/mapX across ChunkRenderer, EntityRenderer, and GameScreen helpers.
verify: Search shows no remaining direct uses of tiltY(...) or SHEAR_X_FROM_Y multiplication at call sites.
All mapping uses VoxelRenderMapping.mapY/mapX or toVoxelRenderSpace helper.
steps.notes: Centralized the mapping so later tuning (nonlinear horizon, shear) touches fewer sites and reduces drift bugs.

steps.desc: Improve cliff face readability without new art: use the tile's ground texture as the side-face base (tinted by caller) instead of waterFill placeholder.
verify: VoxelSideRegions.sideForGroundId delegates to TilesetRegions.ground(groundId).
ChunkRenderer continues to tint faces dark for vertical face illusion.
steps.notes: Side faces now inherit surface material texture, improving voxel-column look without requiring new atlas art.
